taskOrderHashEncoding: UTF-8 task IDs joined with LF characters, with no trailing LF.
guardrails: These summaries are non-authoritative preparation and do not change the source manifest or batch ledger.
Every bundle must be regenerated from fresh production, seed, task and dependency snapshots when it becomes eligible.
The exact active bundle may contain up to five next-PENDING tasks; already-terminal source indices are never reopened merely to make numeric ranges contiguous.
No prepared outcome is authorized until current evidence, citations, target identities, hashes and collision checks pass.
A later reciprocal task may be superseded only after its canonical target reaches the required verified terminal status.
